model.parcel_delivery.delivery_exception.name: delivery_exceptions
model.parcel_delivery.delivery_exception.description: One row per delivery exception, such as a lost, damaged or refused parcel.

case_number.name: case_number
case_number.description: The case number shown to the customer.

updated_at.name: updated_at
updated_at.description: When the exception was last updated.

exception_type.name: exception_type
exception_type.description: The kind of exception, such as lost, damaged or refused.

status.name: status
status.description: The current status of the exception.

status_description.name: status_description
status_description.description: A longer description of the current status.

reason_code.name: reason_code
reason_code.description: The reason code the handler assigned.

channel.name: channel
channel.description: How the exception was reported, such as phone, email or app.

is_escalated.name: is_escalated
is_escalated.description: Whether the exception was escalated to a supervisor.

reviewer_id.name: reviewer_id
reviewer_id.description: The supervisor reviewing the exception, if any.

depot_id.name: depot_id
depot_id.description: The depot responsible for the parcel.

carrier_id.name: carrier_id
carrier_id.description: The carrier that handled the parcel.

origin_country.name: origin_country
origin_country.description: The country the parcel was sent from.

destination_country.name: destination_country
destination_country.description: The country the parcel was sent to.

parcel_size.name: parcel_size
parcel_size.description: The size class of the parcel.

notes_summary.name: notes_summary
notes_summary.description: A summary of the handler's notes.

tracking_number.name: tracking_number
tracking_number.description: The tracking number of the parcel.

model.parcel_delivery.daily_depot_volume.name: daily_depot_volume
model.parcel_delivery.daily_depot_volume.description: One row per depot per day, with the parcel counts that moved through the depot that day.

depot_day_id.name: depot_day_id
depot_day_id.description: Surrogate key of the depot and day.

volume_date.name: volume_date
volume_date.description: The day the counts are for.

carrier.name: carrier
carrier.description: The carrier that handled the parcels.

is_weekend.name: is_weekend
is_weekend.description: Whether the day fell on a weekend.

is_holiday.name: is_holiday
is_holiday.description: Whether the day was a public holiday.

zone_number.name: zone_number
zone_number.description: The delivery zone the depot serves.

region.name: region
region.description: The region the depot is in.

depot_type.name: depot_type
depot_type.description: Whether the depot is a hub, a regional depot or a local depot.

service_level.name: service_level
service_level.description: The service level of the parcels, such as standard or express.

parcels_received.name: parcels_received
parcels_received.description: The number of parcels that arrived at the depot.

parcels_delayed.name: parcels_delayed
parcels_delayed.description: The number of parcels that missed their scheduled departure.

parcels_damaged.name: parcels_damaged
parcels_damaged.description: The number of parcels reported damaged at the depot.

model.parcel_delivery.delivery_runs.name: delivery_runs
model.parcel_delivery.delivery_runs.description: One row per delivery run a driver made from a depot.

depot_id.name: depot_id
depot_id.description: The depot the run left from.

driver_id.name: driver_id
driver_id.description: The driver assigned to the run, if any.

vehicle_plate.name: vehicle_plate
vehicle_plate.description: The licence plate of the vehicle used.

departed_at.name: departed_at
departed_at.description: When the vehicle left the depot.

returned_at.name: returned_at
returned_at.description: When the vehicle returned to the depot.

shift_started_at.name: shift_started_at
shift_started_at.description: When the driver's shift started, including loading time.

shift_ended_at.name: shift_ended_at
shift_ended_at.description: When the driver's shift ended, including unloading time.

scheduled_at.name: scheduled_at
scheduled_at.description: When the run was scheduled to start.

route_type.name: route_type
route_type.description: Whether the route was urban, suburban or rural.

model.parcel_delivery.parcels.name: parcels
model.parcel_delivery.parcels.description: One row per revision of a parcel record.

depot_id.name: depot_id
depot_id.description: The depot that currently holds the parcel.

revision.name: revision
revision.description: The revision number of the record, starting at zero.

scan_events.name: scan_events
scan_events.description: The scan events recorded for the parcel so far.

is_fragile.name: is_fragile
is_fragile.description: Whether the parcel is marked fragile.

is_oversized.name: is_oversized
is_oversized.description: Whether the parcel exceeds the standard size.

is_returned.name: is_returned
is_returned.description: Whether the parcel was returned to sender.

created_at.name: created_at
created_at.description: When the parcel record was created.

last_scanned_at.name: last_scanned_at
last_scanned_at.description: When the parcel was last scanned.

next_scan_due_at.name: next_scan_due_at
next_scan_due_at.description: When the parcel's next scan is expected.

is_delivered.name: is_delivered
is_delivered.description: Whether the parcel has been delivered.

model.parcel_delivery.time_spine.name: time_spine
model.parcel_delivery.time_spine.description: The daily time spine the dbt semantic layer requires. Not a semantic model.
